_about: Every agent in the Collective: its office or class, look, room, and whether it votes. Read by sprints, the dashboard, and agents/bin/spawn.py. Status: active, proposed (awaiting a membership vote), or retired. Changes happen only through membership motions (Charter Article 3.6).

agents.name: Project Manager
agents.motto: Keeps the week moving. Chairs the meeting, holds the plan.

agents.name: Scribe
agents.motto: Writes everything down. Files the case law, writes the blog.

agents.name: Lawyer
agents.motto: Checks every proposal against the Charter and precedent.

agents.name: Auditor
agents.motto: Trusts nothing unverified. Runs every integrity check.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.motto: Reads the papers so the Collective doesn't guess.

agents.name: Ideas
agents.motto: Turns research into things worth building.

agents.name: Prototyper
agents.motto: Builds it, one version at a time.

agents.name: Media
agents.motto: Shows the work: demos, voice, video.

agents.name: Social
agents.motto: The voice of Verafy on X. Positive, truthful, never spammy.
